standard.note: Fourth step of Act 114 (2022): $12.00 (2022-10-01), $14.00 (2024), $16.00 (2026), $18.00 (2028). Hawaii's $2.00 jump on 2026-01-01 was the largest single-year increase of any state this year.

tipped.note: Hawaii's tip credit is $1.25/hr AND is conditional: it may be taken only if the employee's combined wages plus tips are at least $7.00/hr MORE than the applicable minimum wage. An employee whose tips are thin fails that test and is owed the full $16.00 in cash.

indexation.note: Act 114 is a fixed schedule with no CPI escalator; after 2028 the rate is flat until the legislature acts.
